definition: A synthetic porous ultralight solid material is created from a gel through a supercritical drying process, in which the gel's liquid component is replaced with gas.
name: Aerogels

definition: A technique for delivering therapeutic compounds into the body through the skin with minimal invasiveness.
name: Microneedle Drug Delivery

definition: Vertigo or major dizziness associated with abnormal brain activity in migraine affecting the VESTIBULAR SYSTEM.
name: Vestibular Migraine

definition: A physical characteristic of an organism's sex that is not directly related to its REPRODUCTIVE SYSTEM.
name: Sex Differences

definition: A physiological response to awakening. It is a discreet and distinct component of the CORTISOL circadian cycle, with characteristics unrelated to cortisol secretion throughout the rest of the day (Wilhelm et al., 2007; Fries et al., 2009).
name: Cortisol Awakening Response

definition: A chronic functional disorder with vertigo, dizziness and unsteadiness triggered by vestibular episode and psychological stress. Unlike in BENIGN PAROXYSMAL POSITIONAL VERTIGO, the otoliths on the OTOLITHIC MEMBRANE are not involved in pathology of persistent postural-perceptual dizziness.
name: Persistent Postural-Perceptual Dizziness

definition: An abnormal connection between inner ear and the surrounding structures, resulting in a leakage of the PERILYMPH. It is most common in a whiplash-type head trauma injury. Perilymph or labyrinthine fistulas may result in dizziness and/or intermittent hearing loss.
name: Perilymphatic Fistula

definition: Inner ear diseases caused by autoimmune reaction, characterized by audiovestibular dysfunction including TINNITUS; VERTIGO and progressive SENSORINEURAL HEARING LOSS. Autoimmune inner ear disease may coexist with other systemic autoimmune diseases (e.g., COGAN SYNDROME).
name: Autoimmune Inner Ear Disease

definition: Presence of vestibular symptoms such as light-headedness, dizziness or unsteadiness associated with injuries and pathologies of the CERVICAL VERTEBRAE. Cervicogenic dizziness are often associated with a whiplash-type injury and neck pain.
name: Cervical Dizziness

definition: The reduction of the immunogenicity of a population of tumor cells over time, under the GENETIC SELECTION pressure of IMMUNOLOGIC SURVEILLANCE, leading to TUMOR IMMUNE EVASION.
name: Immunoediting, Cancer

definition: Tests in which two tasks are performed simultaneously. Dual-Task Exercises can be used to show the performance differences of subjects in MULTITASKING BEHAVIOR.
name: Dual-Task Tests

definition: A reproductive process where a SURROGATE MOTHER carries and gives birth to a child for another person or couple.
name: Surrogacy

definition: A strategy used in PHARMACEUTIC CHEMISTRY where one part of a molecule is replaced with a different one that has similar physical or chemical properties, but with the aim of enhancing the biological activity, stability, or safety of the molecule.
name: Bioisosterism

definition: A signaling pathway that enables cells to adapt to various stressors by modulating protein synthesis. It is initiated by the activation of specific PROTEIN KINASES (e.g., PERK, GCN2, PKR, and HRI) in response to distinct stress signals, including amino acid deprivation, VIRAL INFECTIONS, and OXIDATIVE STRESS.
name: Integrated Stress Response

definition: The ability to hear and distinguish one SOUND from another. These are typically assessed using whisper tests, tuning fork tests, or BONE CONDUCTION tests.
name: Auditory Acuity

definition: The altered pattern of GENE EXPRESSION related to RNA METHYLATION.
name: Epitranscriptome

definition: Enlargement of the lips most often by injection of DERMAL FILLER.
name: Lip Augmentation

definition: The study of the structure, function, and biology of carbohydrates (sugars) and carbohydrate-containing molecules, known as glycans, in biological systems.
name: Glycobiology

definition: A healthcare professional specializing in evaluating and treating patients with airway and breathing problems.
name: Respiratory Therapists

definition: A specialized transport barrier between the PARENCHYMAL TISSUE of the SPINAL CORD and the surrounding BLOOD VESSELS.
name: Blood-Spinal Cord Barrier

definition: Graphic visual representations of educational content. It is used to deliver complex information, such as RESEARCH results.
name: Infographic

definition: Meshwork of extracellular matrix containing CHONDROITIN SULFATE PROTEOGLYCANS structures interposed among glial processes. Perineuronal nets (PNN) surround the soma and dendrites of certain neuronal cell types, e.g., inhibitory GABAergic PARVALBUMIN-positive INTERNEURONS. PNN plays a role in NEURONAL PLASTICITY and may modulate memory.
name: Perineuronal Nets

definition: Blood vessels in the host site targeted to receive blood from transplanted tissue or SURGICAL FLAPS in various procedures, e.g., MICROSURGERY; PLASTIC SURGERY PROCEDURES; and SURGICAL ANASTOMOSIS.
name: Recipient Vessels

definition: A diagnostic test primarily used to detect TUBERCULOSIS and other respiratory infections.
name: Bacilloscopy

definition: A process where the genome of a pathogen is studied to find genes that may code for antigen proteins. If found, the putative antigen genes are then cloned, expressed in bacteria, and used to vaccinate experimental animals. If the expressed protein is shown to induce protective immunity it then becomes a candidate for further studies as a vaccine to be used to prevent infection.
name: Reverse Vaccinology

definition: Nanostructures formed from DNA. They are used as a scaffold for complex structures due to programmable assembly and control of size, shape, and function.
name: DNA Nanostructures

definition: MILK SUBSTITUITES derived from PLANTS.
name: Plant-based Milk

definition: Longitudinal Studies done in Canada on Ageing Populations
name: Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging

aliases: Autoimmune Inflammatory Syndrome Induced by Adjuvants
definition: An immune disease that is triggered by a variety of ADJUVANTS. It results in a spectrum of autoimmune and inflammatory responses that lead to significant health challenges.
name: Autoimmune-Inflammatory Syndrome Induced by Adjuvants

definition: The state of the VASCULAR SYSTEM when functioning optimally without evidence of disease, disorders, or deficiencies.
name: Vascular Health

definition: Glucuronosyltransferase encoded by UGT1 complex which encodes human bilirubin, phenol, and other UDP-glucuronosyltransferase isozymes with identical carboxyl termini. It catalyzes reactions where lipophilic substrates are conjugated with glucuronic acid to increase the metabolite's water solubility and excretion into either urine or bile. UGT1A1enzyme is essential for elimination and detoxification of drugs, xenobiotics and metabolites.
name: UGT1A1 Enzyme

definition: A cytoskeletal protein and PROTEIN-TYROSINE KINASE substrate that links cytoskeletal structures to the PLASMA MEMBRANE. In EPITHELIAL CELLS, it is essential for the formation of MICROVILLI and membrane ruffles on the apical pole and is also required for macropinocytosis (see PINOCYTOSIS) along with the GUANINE NUCLEOTIDE EXCHANGE FACTOR PLEKHG6.
name: Ezrin

definition: MAP kinase kinase kinase which plays a critical role in cellular responses to environmental stimuli and CYTOKINES.
name: MAP Kinase Kinase Kinase 7

definition: A classical cadherin which plays a critical role in maintaining permeability of the ENDOTHELIUM.
name: Cadherin 5

definition: A family of ACUTE PHASE PROTEINS characterized by a shared pentraxin PROTEIN DOMAIN. They include C-reactive protein and serum amyloid P component and function in the regulation of INNATE IMMUNITY and INFLAMMATION.
name: Pentraxins

definition: Viruses with a monopartitite or bipartite positive-strand RNA genome that share the following properties: auto-proteolytically processed polyprotein(s), a common three-domain replication block (Hel-Pro-Pol domain consisting of a superfamily III helicase, a proteinase with a chymotrypsin-like structure and a superfamily I RNA-dependent RNA polymerase) and non-enveloped icosahedral virions approximately 30 nm in diameter with a pseudo-T=3 symmetry.
name: Picornavirales

definition: The catalyst to phosphorylate SPHINGOSINE into sphingosine-1-phosphate; Important in ANGIOGENESIS, CELL SURVIVAL, and CELL MIGRATION
name: Sphingosine Kinase

definition: A proteoglycan involved in joint surface lubrication and encoded by the PRG4 gene. Altered expression occurs in some forms of ARTHRITIS.
name: Proteoglycan 4

definition: A myosin-binding protein found in the SARCOMERES of STRIATED MUSCLE. Iit has slow and fast paralogs. Myosin-binding protein C regulates systolic and diastolic activity in MYOCARDIUM and muscle contraction in SKELETAL MUSCLE.
name: Myosin Binding Protein C

definition: A non-invasive and radiation-free imaging modality that detects superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticles (SPIONs) to create high-contrast, real-time images.
name: Magnetic Particle Imaging

definition: A large, gelatin-degrading membrane SERINE ENDOPEPTIDASE complex expressed by stromal FIBROBLASTS of epithelial cancers; it is a biomarker for MELANOMA cell invasiveness.
name: Fibroblast Activation Protein Alpha

aliases: Solute Carrier Family 11-(proton-coupled divalent metal ion transporters), Member 1
definition: A cation transport protein that shares structural homology with prokaryotic and eukaryotic transport proteins. In mammals, it is a MACROPHAGE-specific antiporter, transporting metal ions in either direction against a proton gradient, and localizes to membranes of late ENDOSOMES and LYSOSOMES, where it may contribute to antimicrobial activity.
name: Natural Resistance-associated Macrophage Protein 1

aliases: Early Population Doubling Level Cdna-1 ProteinEarly Population Doubling Level Cdna-1 Protein
definition: A neurotrophic protein and serpin that induces CELL DIFFERENTIATION in RETINOBLASTOMA cells and also functions as an ANGIOGENESIS INHIBITOR in the mammalian eye.
name: Pigment Epithelium-Derived Factor

definition: A mammalian endoglucuronidase which degrades HEPARAN SULFATE glycosaminoglycans into short 5-6 kDa pieces.
name: Heparanase

definition: A ubiquitin regulator which encodes a coiled-coil domain that interacts with STATHMIN and is involved in endosomal protein sorting
name: Tsg101 Protein

definition: A secreted glycoprotein that controls activation of signaling pathways in adjacent cells (PARACRINE COMMUNICATION) for processes that include CELL ADHESION; CELL MIGRATION; and organization of the CYTOSKELETON. It is primarily expressed in the RETINA and variants in the myocillin gene cause GLAUCOMA 1, OPEN ANGLE, A.
name: Myocilin

definition: A component of TRANSPORT VESICLES that contain GLUT4 PROTEIN. It functions in the transport and processing of LDL RECEPTORS.
name: Sortilin

definition: Serine-threonine-protein kinases that regulates a variety of ION CHANNELS and MEMBRANE TRANSPORT PROTEINS, as well as cellular processes that include neuronal excitability, CELL PROLIFERATION; CELL SURVIVAL; and APOPTOSIS. They also have important roles in the cellular stress response (STRESS, PHYSIOLOGICAL), renal sodium retention and potassium elimination.
name: Serum-Glucocorticoid Regulated Kinases

definition: An interferon regulatory factor regulated by INTERFERON-GAMMA that binds the interferon-inducible ENHANCER ELEMENTS of HISTOCOMPATIBILITY ANTIGENS CLASS I genes.
name: Interferon Regulatory Factor-8

definition: A histone deacetylase that catalyzes the deacetylation of the core HISTONES (H2A, H2B,H3, and H4) as well as other cellular proteins. It functions in the CELL NUCLEUS as part of the nuclear-receptor corepressor complex to regulate the GENETIC TRANSCRIPTION of NUCLEAR RECEPTORS.
name: Histone Deacetylase 3

definition: The major structural protein of vault ribonucleoprotein particles, which function in NUCLEOCYTOPLASMIC TRANSPORT and SIGNAL TRANSDUCTION.
name: Major Vault Protein

definition: The terminal OXIDOREDUCTASE in the plant mitochondrial electron transport chain utilized in the alternative pathway of respiration. It limits REACTIVE OXYGEN SPECIES production and bypasses ELECTRON TRANSPORT COMPLEX III and ELECTRON TRANSPORT COMPLEX IV to keep metabolic homeostasis during PHYSIOLOGICAL STRESS.
name: Alternative Oxidase

definition: A lysophospholipase that catalyzes the hydrolysis of GLYCEROPHOSPHOLIPIDS to produce LYSOPHOSPHATIDIC ACIDS and corresponding AMINES. Autotaxin is secreted lysophospholipase D and produces lysophosphatidic acid in EXTRACELLULAR FLUID.
name: Lysophospholipase D

definition: A glucagon-like peptide and GLP-1 agonist used to enhance glycemic control of TYPE 2 DIABETES MELLITUS, and for OBESITY MANAGEMENT.
name: Semaglutide

definition: A signal transduction pathway that involves cGMP-AMP synthase (cGAS), stimulator of interferon genes (STING), and downstream signaling adaptors. This pathway plays an essential role in the innate immune system by activating immune defenses, particularly against invading pathogens or harmful damage.
name: cGAS-STING Signaling Pathway

definition: A membrane protein that functions in INNATE IMMUNITY and INFLAMMATION through the CGAS-STING SIGNALING PATHWAY. It acts as a sensor of cytosolic DNA from bacteria and viruses and promotes the production of INTERFERON TYPE I.
name: STING Protein

definition: A scaffold protein originally thought to function as a SERINE-THREONINE PROTEIN KINASE. It lacks kinase activity and regulates a variety of cellular processes that include CELL ADHESION; CELL MIGRATION; and assembly of FOCAL ADHESIONS.
name: Scaffold Protein ILK

definition: A thymosin that functions to regulate organization of the CYTOSKELETON. It binds to and sequesters ACTIN monomers to inhibit POLYMERIZATION and also inhibits CELL DIFFERENTIATION of some STEM CELLS.
name: Thymosin beta(4)

definition: A serine-threonine-protein kinase which senses damaged MITOCHONDRIA and protects against mitochondrial dysfunction caused by PHYSIOLOGICAL STRESS. It phosphorylates proteins on the OUTER MITOCHONDRIAL MEMBRANE to coordinate quality control mechanisms that remove and replace dysfunctional mitochondrial components. Mutations in the PINK1 gene, which encodes PTEN-induced putative kinase, are associated with PARKINSON DISEASE.
name: PTEN-Induced Putative Kinase

definition: A developmental process in which NEURONS extend and form SYNAPSES.
name: Neurodevelopment

definition: A therapeutic approach that focuses on modulating the host's immunity or interfering with cell mechanisms necessary for pathogen function, rather than focusing on pathogens themselves.
name: Host-Directed Therapy

definition: Proteins that cotransport sodium ions and iodide ions across cellular membranes. They function in the biosynthesis of TRIIODOTHYRONINE and THYROXINE.
name: Sodium-Iodide Symporters

definition: A G-PROTEIN-COUPLED RECEPTOR found in RETINAL GANGLION CELLS that regulates non-image forming visual functions like CIRCADIAN RHYTHM responses and pupil dilation.
name: Melanopsin

definition: A regulatory membrane peptide of SARCOPLASMIC RETICULUM CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES. Its phosphorylation by CYCLIC AMP-DEPENDENT PROTEIN KINASES allows protein kinase-induced stimulation of calcium transport.
name: Phospholamban

definition: A subclass of retinol-binding proteins that take part in the transport of RETINOL between the ROD CELL OUTER SEGMENT and RETINAL PIGMENT EPITHELIUM. Do not confuse with inverted repeat binding protein (also known as IRBP).
name: Retinol-Binding Proteins, Interstitial

definition: Transmembrane proteoglycans expressed in OLIGODENDROCYTE PRECURSOR CELLS; NEUROGLIA: and PERICYTES. It is a biomarker and treatment target for MELANOMA.
name: Chondroitin Sulfate Proteoglycan 4

definition: A type of regulated cell death that is triggered by the accumulation of COPPER in MITOCHONDRIA.
name: Cuproptosis

definition: A secretion produced by honey BEES that consists of water, protein, MONOSACCHARIDES; and FATTY ACIDS that include 10-hydroxy-2-decenoic acid, sebacic acid, 10-hydroxydecanoic acid, and 9-oxo-2-decanoic acid. It also contains trace amounts of MINERALS; ANTI-BACTERIAL COMPOUNDS; B VITAMINS; and VITAMIN C.
name: Royal Jelly

definition: A minimally invasive procedure for delivering aerosolized chemotherapy into the PERITONEUM.
name: Pressurized Intraperitoneal Aerosol Chemotherapy

definition: A p300-CBP transcription factor with intrinsic HISTONE ACETYLASE activity that functions to promote TRANSCRIPTIONAL ACTIVATION. Among its functions is suppression of the CELL CYCLE where it competes with ADENOVIRUS E1A PROTEINS.
name: p300-CBP-Associated Factor

definition: A carbocyclic nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor with potent and selective anti-HIV activity.
name: Abacavir

definition: A repressor protein that restricts neuronal gene transcription in non-neuronal cells.
name: RE1-Silencing Transcription Factor

definition: An acute-phase protein that binds to the lipid a moiety of bacterial LIPOPOLYSACCHARIDES, a glycolipid present in the outer membrane of all GRAM-NEGATIVE BACTERIA. The Lipopolysaccharide-Binding Proteins/Lipopolysaccharide complex may be involved in immune response by interacting with the CD14 ANTIGEN
name: Lipopolysaccharide-Binding Protein

definition: An ETS MOTIF - containing trans-activator that functions in HEMATOPOIESIS. It activates transcription of critical genes by making genomic regions within HETEROCHROMATIN accessible to other key transcription factors.
name: Proto-Oncogene Protein Spi-1

definition: A nucleotidyltransferase that catalyzes the formation of cyclic GMP-AMP in mammals. This activates the STING1 PROTEIN through the CGAS-STING SIGNALING PATHWAY, which triggers the production of INTERFERON TYPE I and other CYTOKINES.
name: Cyclic Guanosine Monophosphate-Adenosine Monophosphate Synthase

definition: A cysteine endopeptidase that occurs in LYSOSOMES of MACROPHAGES where it hydrolyzes molecules containing ASPARAGINE. It plays a critical role in ANTIGEN PRESENTATION.
name: Asparaginyl Endopeptidase

definition: A condition that is characterized by episodes of sudden uncontrollable and inappropriate laughing or crying. It can result from certain neurological conditions or injuries that may impact the way the brain controls emotions.
name: Pseudobulbar Affect

definition: A congenital defect with major fissure in the ABDOMINAL WALL at the UMBILICUS resulting in the extrusion of VISCERA through the UMBILICUS. Unlike GASTROSCHISIS, omphalocele is covered with PERITONEUM but without overlying SKIN.
name: Omphalocele

definition: A group of barrel-shaped imidazolines composed of (n) glycoluril monomers linked by methylene bridges and are often abbreviated CB[n] or CB*[n]. They have a high binding affinity to CATIONS and neutral molecules.
name: Cucurbit(n)urils

definition: A transcriptional coactivator protein highly expressed in SMOOTH MUSCLE CELLS and CARDIOMYOCYTES. It functions as a cofactor for SERUM RESPONSE FACTOR and regulates smooth muscle contraction, smooth muscle CELL DIFFERENTIATION, and cardiac muscle development.
name: Myocardin

definition: Amidohydrolases that catalyze the hydrolysis of endogenous amidated lipids such as OLEYLAMIDE and ANANDAMIDE to FATTY ACIDS, resulting in changes to their roles in SIGNAL TRANSDUCTION.
name: Fatty Acid Amide Hydrolases

definition: A ligand for RECEPTOR PROTEIN-TYROSINE KINASES AXL, TYRO3 and MERTK through which it regulates cell growth and survival of ENDOTHELIAL CELLS; CELL ADHESION; and CELL MIGRATION. GAS6 also has critical roles in the development of NATURAL KILLER CELLS and PLATELET ACTIVATION.
name: Growth Arrest-Specific Protein 6

definition: A laboratory phenomenon where a low platelet count is observed due to the action of ANTICOAGULANTS such as EDTA causing platelet AGGLUTINATION.
name: Pseudothrombocytopenia

definition: DNA that occurs outside of CHROMOSOMES in prokaryotic or eukaryotic cells.
name: Extrachromosomal DNA

definition: A multienzyme complex that carries out DNA REPLICATION. Replisomes consist of DNA HELICASES; REPLICATION FACTOR C; PROLIFERATING CELL NUCLEAR ANTIGEN; DNA GYRASE; DNA TOPOISOMERASES; DNA LIGASES; and RIBONUCLEASE H.
name: Replisomes

definition: Neuronal proteins that bind to F-ACTIN and modulate the morphology of DENDRITIC SPINES, as well as excitatory SYNAPTIC TRANSMISSION through their regulatory effects on PROTEIN PHOSPHATASE 1.
name: Neurabins

definition: Membrane proteins which share sequence similarity with FRIZZLED RECEPTORS and participate in a variety of CELL SIGNALING activities that regulate CELL GROWTH PROCESSES and MORPHOGENESIS.
name: Frizzled-Related Proteins

definition: Methods that analyze the location and levels of gene expression within intact tissues.
name: Spatial Transcriptomics

definition: A tyrosine kinase receptor inhibitor that targets mutants of PROTO-ONCOGENE PROTEIN KIT and PLATELET-DERIVED GROWTH FACTOR ALPHA RECEPTOR.
name: Avapritinib

definition: A calcium- and diacylglycerol-independent protein kinase C that protects against APOPTOSIS and functions in NF-KAPPA B signaling, CELL DIFFERENTIATION and CELL POLARITY.
name: Protein Kinase C-lambda

definition: Anionic polyelectrolytes that contain metal-oxo clusters. They are often used in CATALYSIS due to their structural variation and versatility.
name: Polyoxometalates

definition: A RACEMASE which catalyzes the conversion of L-Serine to D-Serine.
name: Serine Racemase

definition: A thiolesterase that catalyzes the production of GLUTATHIONE and D-LACTIC ACID from the hydrolysis of S-D-lactoyl-glutathione. In vertebrates, only one gene that encodes hydroxyacylglutathione hydrolase is known to occur. In yeast and higher plants, separate genes encode the cytosolic and mitochondrial forms of this enzyme.
name: Hydroxyacylglutathione Hydrolase

definition: A technique involving a trained practitioner who places their hands on, or above a patient with the intent to guide a flow of energy into the patient. Depending upon beliefs, the goal of the procedure can include energetic healing, SPIRITUAL HEALING, or both forms of healing. While Reiki sessions may be offered on a massage table, it is distinct from MASSAGE THERAPY, which involves the physical manipulation of muscles and tissues.
name: Reiki

definition: An open heart surgery to treat HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY.
name: Septal Myectomy

definition: Persons who reside in NURSING HOMES.
name: Nursing Home Residents

definition: An extracellular matrix protein that is highly expressed in ODONTOBLASTS. It is cleaved into 2 chains: dentin sialoprotein and dentin phosphoprotein. Mutations in the human DSPP gene, which encodes dentin sialophosphoprotein, can cause DENTINOGENESIS IMPERFECTA.
name: Dentin Sialophosphoprotein

definition: Pharmacologic or non-pharmacologic methods used to improve COGNITION or AFFECT in people, especially in those who are not experiencing MENTAL DISORDERS.
name: Cognitive Enhancement

definition: Skin neoplasms that are not MELANOMA.
name: Non-Melanoma Skin Neoplasms

aliases: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Skin
definition: A non-melanoma skin neoplasm that is one of the three principal types of skin cancer. It often presents as a hard lump or ulcer and is more likely to metastasize than BASAL CELL CARCINOMA.
name: Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma

definition: An endovascular procedure to replace a diseased or damaged MITRAL VALVE.
name: Transcatheter Mitral Valve Replacement

definition: Protein serine-threonine kinases that regulate cell growth and CELL PROLIFERATION in the HIPPO SIGNALING PATHWAY. They control mammalian cell and organ size.
name: Hippo Kinases

definition: plasma biomarker for ALZHEIMER DISEASE
name: pTau217

definition: a mu-opioid receptor agonist
name: tegileridine

definition: fully humanized IgG4 monoclonal antibody against PD-1 receptor
name: serplulimab

definition: Nectin-4a-binding bicyclic peptide consisting of a cleavable linker system and the cell penetrant toxin mono-methylauristatin E (MMAE)
name: zelenectide pevedotin
